baseState.clinical: Administered intravenously. Often combined with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) and leucovorin. Patients are strictly advised to avoid cold drinks and exposure to cold air for 3-5 days post-infusion.

dnaState.clinical: Mismatch Repair (MMR) proteins fail to recognize the DACH-distorted DNA adducts. This prevents the cancer cell from initiating repair bypass mechanisms, permanently halting DNA synthesis.
